neighbourhoods.name: Andover

neighbourhoods.name: Stockbridge

neighbourhoods.name: Test Valley villages
neighbourhoods.housing: Rural villages of thatched cottages, flint and brick houses and farm buildings.

housing: Test Valley runs from Andover in the north to Romsey and the edge of Southampton in the south. Andover grew as a London overspill town, so much of its housing is post-war estates, with large new-build areas added recently. Romsey and the river villages have older period homes, and many rural cottages are thatched or listed. Private renting is below the South East average, with some lets to military families from the nearby army bases.
checkinTips: Thatched cottages in the Test valley villages: photograph the thatch, chimneys, low beams and any damp in old walls.
Overspill estate homes in Andover: check window seals, garages in blocks and shared paths and parking courts.
New-build homes at Augusta Park and Picket Twenty: note snagging marks, fences, turf and any management company areas.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank or LPG supply, fuel level and boiler service label.
Homes near the River Test in Romsey and Stockbridge: check ground floors and walls for damp or past flood marks.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Test Valley Borough Council's Private Sector Housing Team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions.
